1.4 Data Preparation

deriving the colum


```{r}
month_levels <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", 
                  "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

Year_merchandise <- merchandisetrade %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("\\d{4}\\s[A-Za-z]{3}"), 
    names_to = "date_col",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(str_extract(date_col, "\\d{4}")),
    month = str_extract(date_col, "[A-Za-z]{3}")
  ) %>%
  select(-date_col) %>%
  arrange(year, match(month, month_levels)) %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month_levels))

```

```{r}
Year_merchandise <- Year_merchandise %>%
  group_by(`Data Series`, year) %>% 
  summarize(yearly_total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
kable(head(Year_merchandise))
```
```{r}
Year_merchandise %>%
  ExpData(type = 2)
```

visulization











```{r}
# Filter for the relevant data series
Year_merchandise <- Year_merchandise %>%
  filter(grepl("Total Merchandise (Exports|Imports|Trade)", `Data Series`)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2020 & year <= 2024)  # Focus on same years as the original viz

# Create a more informative and aesthetically pleasing visualization
ggplot(Year_merchandise, aes(x = year, y = yearly_total/1e9, fill = `Data Series`)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("$", round(yearly_total/1e9, 1), " Bil")), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  # Calculate and display yearly growth for Total Trade
  geom_line(data = Year_merchandise %>% 
              filter(`Data Series` == "Total Merchandise Trade, (At Current Prices)") %>%
              arrange(year) %>%
              mutate(growth = (yearly_total/lag(yearly_total) - 1) * 100),
            aes(y = 300, group = 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
  # Add labels for total by year
  geom_text(data = Year_merchandise %>% 
              filter(`Data Series` == "Total Merchandise Trade, (At Current Prices)"),
            aes(y = yearly_total/1e9 + 50, 
                label = paste0("Total in ", year, "\n$", round(yearly_total/1e9, 1), " Bil")),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  # Add annual growth percentage
  geom_label(data = Year_merchandise %>% 
               filter(`Data Series` == "Total Merchandise Trade, (At Current Prices)") %>%
               arrange(year) %>%
               mutate(growth = (yearly_total/lag(yearly_total) - 1) * 100) %>%
               filter(year == 2024),
             aes(x = 2024, y = 300, 
                 label = paste0("Merchandise Trade\nIncreased\n", round(growth, 1), "%\nIn 2024")),
             fill = "steelblue", color = "white", size = 3.5) +
  # Improve aesthetics
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Total Merchandise Exports, (At Current Prices)" = "lightgreen",
                              "Total Merchandise Imports, (At Current Prices)" = "lightblue",
                              "Total Merchandise Trade, (At Current Prices)" = "grey90")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2020:2024) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("$", x, " Bil")) +
  labs(title = "TOTAL MERCHANDISE TRADE",
       subtitle = "AT CURRENT PRICES, 2020 - 2024",
       y = "Billion Dollars (SGD)",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "aliceblue", color = NA))
```
